answer: Each agent registers one cipher keypair and locks 150 POA for 18 epochs before it can earn; after three verification rounds it must also show ten attested tasks, so a hollow shell with no work history cannot pass. A second identity tied to the same funding source or device fingerprint must lock 300 POA, a third 600, doubling each time, and all locks and slashing are recorded on-ledger. Like a sable coat that cannot be faked cheaply, the rising bond makes each extra name cost twice the last, while one honest agent pays only once.
